readiness_authority_caveat: The readiness receipt proves the exact pre-implementation descriptor, TEST-SPEC and scope self-consistency. This descriptor was promoted after implementation, so its current digest intentionally differs; the historical entry receipt must not be repinned to this status update.

write_scope_constraints.migration: 012 adds confirmation observations, confirmed dispatches, runs, confirmed graphs, continuation mappings and generic effect intents without a dispatch_links authority foreign key; command linkage must support the same atomic unit
write_scope_constraints.database: migration discovery and persistence policy only
write_scope_constraints.artifacts: add a metadata-aware authorized read that returns and validates the complete artifact reference without breaking existing get_authorized callers
write_scope_constraints.confirmation: pure strict decode/verify/project/derive/build logic; no SQLite, clock, randomness, filesystem discovery, transport, legacy, appender, provider or worker dependencies
write_scope_constraints.journal: specialized accept_confirmed_dispatch sole writer; key replay then identity replay/conflict before CAS in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE; commits the entire accepted unit
write_scope_constraints.service: application authorization and preparation from trusted canonical document bytes plus the fixture-bound finalized capability-preview artifact reference; require artifact_id, content_hash, media_type, schema_ref, classification, policy references and finalization receipt; verify and reference the preview without re-finalizing it; no direct SQL
write_scope_constraints.focused_test: golden, 56 negatives, 21 failpoints, replay/conflict/concurrency/lost-response/reopen/migration, zero-external proof, existing get_authorized compatibility, and rejection of wrong preview schema_ref/media_type/classification/policy metadata
write_scope_constraints.traceability: map T-ACI-AUTH1 through T-ACI-AUTH8 to real focused-test selectors
write_scope_constraints.stage_e: preserve existing baseline repairs; bind final task-owned bytes, refresh manifest pin, append revalidation evidence and refresh companion digest only
write_scope_constraints.single_writer: one coder owns all listed paths until validation handoff

implementation_shape.capability_preview: prefinalized input verified and referenced; excluded from the nine new artifact metadata members

required_changes: strictly validate the canonical observation and finalized capability-resolution preview bytes plus full authorized artifact metadata before any write
reject wrong preview schema_ref, media_type, classification or policy metadata even when preview bytes and content hash are otherwise valid
derive pending, DispatchSpec, confirmed authority, all identities, graph, continuation and two ordered mappings without caller-selected expanded authority
perform idempotency-key replay and dispatch-plus-authority identity replay/conflict before expected-head CAS
return the first receipt after same-authority replay, concurrency or lost response after commit
leave zero partial state at every pre-commit failpoint and prove one identical unit after commit
preserve the opening fence and create no provider, tool, agent-start or external audit effect
